svg.aria-label: Density against radius at time 1 for the Sedov point blast of Kamm and Timmes. The exact profile rises steeply to 6 at radius 1 and drops to 1 outside. The Godunov profiles at 100, 200 and 400 cells peak at 3.06, 3.76 and 4.40, just inside radius 1, and their outer edges approach radius 1 as the cells shrink.
